import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Convert 'alive' column to numerical values
df['alive'] = df['alive'].map({'yes': 1, 'no': 0})

# Create a bar chart to show the distribution of survived passengers by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='alive', data=df)
plt.title('Survival Distribution by Sex')
plt.xlabel('Sex')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
